owners.conditions: Optional arguments are existence/literal-position checks, not fixed arity or boolean evaluation. Side-effect insertion and subsequent battle execution remain separate. Rendering does not prove legality/PP/target/hit/result.
owners.increment: WP75 §8.2 is identical. Event shorthand prefixes do not broaden six-family script-name matching or optional positions. WP74 names/offset/cache are identical.

owners.route: WP46 per-hit rendering -> WP74 slots/mappings; actual damage/HP/effect ordering remains domain contract
owners.conditions: Animation happens in each actual move stage, distinct from damage plan, HP submission, reactions and healing/drain/recoil. Slot/frame/opacity cannot stand for HP.
owners.increment: WP74 identical; five repaired clauses/cases do not alter per-hit values/ordering, HP-average limits, OHKO loading or 139/extra1 identity.

owners.route: WP47-A dynamic cartridge base type, environment borrowed move and Ghost/non-Ghost branch -> animation name and offset -> WP74
owners.conditions: Type queried at execution can differ from later animation query; usable registered cartridge and actual branch gates apply. Environment unresolved CONFUSIO is not repaired by a name-prefix rule; Ghost display offset is not targeting.
owners.increment: Keeps actual indirect animation route despite no direct dispatched path. WP47-A and WP74 identical; event-prefix case-insensitivity is not transferred to move/Common names or identities. B11 is not the phone owner.

owners.route: WP74 presentation data/lookup versus WP51–53 AI score/effect-binding boundary
owners.conditions: Predicted score is neither actual damage nor success; queries may have side effects without universal rollback. Animation existence is not valid effect binding or complete AI proof.
owners.increment: WP74/AI body and coverage outputs identical; phone/shape/window/IO/prefix repair does not feed AI effect binding or change overall/target failures, skill gates, item qualification or partner priority.

owners.route: WP74 Copy/Paste independence versus Insert alias, animation presentation; WP77 facility capability reader -> WP54–58 eligibility/session/recording
owners.conditions: Animation properties independence cannot be transferred to recording field serialization, restoration, substitution or Factory cancellation commits. Facility configuration/consumer presence leaves receptionist Demo chain unproved.

owners.increment: WP75 §8.4 and center recognition line identical. New four prefix rules are independent of healing literal cases/SellItem/center recognition; C024 stage failures do not provide global recovery. Time/weather/fishing/berry clauses unchanged.

owners.increment: WP74 and all owned UI/body/catalog outputs identical. C024 partial IO/phone message failure cannot be extended to every UI entry, BoxLink indexing, item selection, BP or finite slots.

owners.increment: Game Corner line and G08 gap line identical; all 13 own body/catalog outputs identical. Nearby shape getter repair does not change mini-game states/random domains/rewards or old card/puzzle counterexamples.
